name: Options
oneLine: Karpman's idea that you can choose which ego state to answer from, instead of the one you were addressed in.
whatYouDid: Arjun addressed Priya's Parent from his Child; you chose to answer from Adult instead of accepting the role he offered.
confusion: People often believe they must answer in the state they were addressed; the tell is that this belief is exactly what keeps a game going - the other person is offering you a role, not assigning one.

fromBook.quote: you always have a choice of ego state in which to respond

expand.definition: Karpman's options matrix lists every ego-state reply available to a given stimulus, showing that the "expected" reply is only one of several legitimate choices.
expand.otherFraming: This is the same freedom as crossing a transaction (concept 18) - options is the general principle, crossing is one concrete move it licenses.
expand.tryThisToday: Next time you feel pulled to answer in kind, pause and name the ego state actually being addressed before you choose your reply.
